section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Nutrition & Food Components — Deep 2
subject: Science
stem: Foods like rice, wheat, and potatoes are rich in which nutrient, which serves as the body's primary and quickest source of energy?
explanation: Carbohydrates (found in cereals, potatoes, sugar) are the body's main and most readily used energy source, broken down into glucose for quick energy release.

section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Nutrition & Food Components — Deep 2
subject: Science
stem: Foods like pulses, milk, eggs, and meat are especially important for growing children mainly because they are rich in:

options.option_text: Proteins, needed for growth and repair of body tissues
Carbohydrates only, needed purely for quick energy
Roughage only, needed purely for digestion

explanation: Proteins (from pulses, milk, eggs, meat) are the body's building blocks, essential for the growth and repair of muscles and tissues — especially critical during childhood growth.
